data.post: Albany - Esperance - Cape Le Grand National Park. Spent the day in Albany on my e-mountain bike exploring the town and the nearby wind farm. My first month in Perth. Iâm settling into the job and new environment, everything seems pretty nice here. I'm looking forward to seeing the sunset as I run towards the finish :). I'll have my race number, 1897, on the front and I'll be in my Tri Alliance tri suit as pictured. If you see me on the run, say something funny. One of my team mates has the best advice for supporters -'don't tell me I'm almost there, I guarantee you I know exactly how far I've got to go' :)
